context: M17 o2. The papered window on W 37th. A rental agent with a key ring, smiling too much.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Two chairs, a sink, a window. I can pay six months in advance. Cash.

lines.speaker: npc.rental_agent
lines.text: The owner prefers… established tenants. Bank references.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: I have twenty references. They're women. None of them have banks.

lines.speaker: npc.rental_agent
lines.text: Then I'm afraid it's no. Have a nice day, miss.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule ten: when the clerk says no, find the man who owns the clerk.
